Subject: Discovery recap & next steps: capacity sizing + demo

Hi Chloe —

Thanks again for making time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before the technical deep dive:

- Use case: low-latency document ingestion + semantic search for internal compliance workflows (batch + streaming).
- Expected steady-state: ~120k documents/day, peak bursts up to 4k reqs/min for embed+knn lookups.
- Desired p99 latency: <= 350ms for generation/response in the production path.
- Security: VPC-only deployment preferred; need KMS integration and audit logs for requests.

Our main asks for the sizing call:
1) Verify GPU footprint estimate for candidate models (13B quantized variants + caching).
2) Align on batching and prefix-caching strategy to meet p99 SLO while keeping cost within our CIDR-based budget.
3) Run through mutual action plan and procurement timeline.

Can we book a 60-minute technical sizing call next week with your infra/sales engineering lead? Ben or Jordan on your side would be ideal. Here are times that work for our team (ET):
- Tue May 4: 10:00–11:00 or 16:00–17:00
- Wed May 5: 09:00–10:00 or 14:00–15:00

I attached a short infra snapshot (small tarball) and a CSV with a representative traffic sample. If you prefer, we can send a trimmed dataset before the call.

Thanks — Samir
